sigma_mount_status: UNMEASURED -- every condition has exactly one physical mount, so setup variance is not identifiable and no GUM U95 budget can be built from this campaign. Needs the U_anchor block.

factor_matrix.note: condition-level scores. Protocols are distinct deployment questions, not an ordered difficulty ladder.

protocols.random_acquisition: LEAKY NEGATIVE CONTROL -- repeats of one condition straddle folds. Included only to quantify what the field's default split buys.
protocols.condition: Interpolation to unseen mass/angle COMBINATIONS on the sampled grid.
protocols.magnitude_interpolating: Leave one interior total-unbalance level out at a time. Endpoint levels are excluded, so every scored level is bracketed by lower and higher levels in training.
protocols.magnitude_extrapolating: Train on total U<36 g.mm and test on total U>=36 g.mm. This is a high-total-unbalance holdout; loading composition is not matched.
protocols.configuration: Leave-one-loaded-configuration-out (D1 / D2 / in-phase / anti-phase); the baseline-only calibration group is not scored.
protocols.angle_sector: Leave-one-angle-sector-out. Only 4 distinct angles exist at U>=24 g.mm, so on-grid phase scores cannot be read as generalization.
